requirement: Return every live criterion as an id and name item, sorted by name ascending and read without tracking; soft-deleted criteria are excluded and duplicate names stay separate rows.

preconditions.text: The criterion table contains the rows seeded for the case
One of the seeded criteria is soft-deleted
Two live criteria share the same name

inputs.text: Query with no parameters over criteria inserted out of order
Query with no parameters over five live criteria plus a soft-deleted one
Query with no parameters on an empty database
Query with no parameters when exactly one criterion exists
Query with no parameters when two criteria share a name

returns.text: Success with the criteria projected as id and name pairs
Duplicate names are returned as separate rows with distinct ids
An empty list is returned when no live criterion exists

exception_text: No unhandled exception; the read-only query has no failure branch
